marquee.headline: Which of your customers are about to stop buying?
paragraphs: Most brands find out from the cohort report. Three months too late.

RetentionX forecasts churn risk for every customer, so the winback goes out while they are still listening. Plank+Beam did exactly that. One campaign aimed at RetentionX's churn predictions recovered 1.17% of customers they would otherwise have lost, in ten days. That was a 14x return on the monthly subscription.

It runs on your Shopify data and puts customer intelligence, identity resolution, attribution and automation in one platform. ARCHIVIST added $251,000 in annual revenue from its lookalike audiences alone.

welcome.headline: Know which customers are worth keeping, and which ones are leaving
paragraphs: RetentionX is a customer intelligence platform for Shopify brands. It connects to your store and gives you LTV, cohorts, RFM segments, attribution and churn forecasts in one place. Then it sends those audiences to the email and ad tools you already use.

The point is acting on the data. NICKIS used its RFM analysis to find high-potential first-time buyers and push them toward a second order. ARCHIVIST added $251,000 in annual revenue from RetentionX lookalike audiences.
Plans start at $49/month and scale with revenue, with a 30-day free trial.
